text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Today, I came with <chrname> to the finals venue 
tour that Ryoka Tsurugi had invited us to.

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoaa~~!! Are we really holding the 
finals here~~!!

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It really is huge...! I'm already getting 
hyped just looking at it...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
You can also view the inside of the venue 
today, so allow me to show you around. 
Please follow me, everyone.

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... amazing...! It's even more intense 
than seeing it on TV...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up at the stadium from the track 
was a magnificent sight. One could only 
wonder how breathtaking it would look once 
the stands were filled with spectators on 
race day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of something distinct from the 
roar of the racecourse, I immersed myself 
in the moment with <chrname>—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Everyone seems so happy—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: …………Elfie.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —It feels like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
To think we could hold the "U.A.F." in 
such a massive venue...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—You're the one who made it come true, 
Elfi.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Your passion, as you've strived all this 
time up to today to spread the wonder of 
sports.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Because the athletes and the audience 
responded to that sparkle... the U.A.F. 
was able to grow this big.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
So this isn't a lie—it's the truth. It's 
the stage of your "dream" that you made 
come true.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san――

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm happy you said that. But 
still――――!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"—The reason I'm able to stand here right 
now is all thanks to you, Ryoka-san!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
It's all because you worked so hard for 
the U.A.F. until today, Suzuka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Because you helped me so, so much... 
Because you supported me...!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Because you took my wish, my dream, so 
seriously that day...!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Because you were the one who found me, 
Suzuka-san! That's why I'm standing right 
here today!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
That's why this is it! This is the stage 
of "our dream"—mine and Suzuka-san's!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Really...! Thank you so, so very much!!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Elfie...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
For believing in me back then... and 
entrusting your "dream" to me...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Thank you, truly.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
...Even when this 'U.A.F.' comes to an 
end, I will――

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"I want to spread the U.A.F. even further 
across the world...! To expand the 
possibilities of sports!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: So, Ryoka-san!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Please continue to... be my partner from 
now on, too!!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: —Of course.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
From now on... let's keep making them come 
true together.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
For brand-new entertainment, and the 
further potential of sports.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, first we need to make 
the Finals tournament the absolute best it 
can be."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Heheh. You bet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the venue tour finished and 
excitement for the finals building up, 
just as we were about to head home—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Trainer! <chrname>-san!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —This is a renewed declaration of war!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
In this U.A.F., I will definitely become 
the No. 1 Athlete Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
By beating all of you, my greatest 
rivals!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Let's have a match that's fiercely 
dazzling and totally sparkly!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can tell that Sononet Elfie's passion is 
burning hotter than ever before...!
choice_data_list: That's just what I was hoping for!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with <chrname>, I exchanged a firm 
handshake with Sonon Elfie—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I vowed in my heart to make the year-end 
tournament finals the absolute best ever!
